verdict.rationale: Docs confirm 1% cashback on every corporate card purchase (jeeves-docs-18) alongside automated card controls, but there's no explicit statement that cashback accrues automatically without redemption steps — it's just a stated card feature. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of automatic accrual/payout mechanics, absence of any redemption flow, and independent/hands-on corroboration that cashback is credited without founder action.
